newsitem.title: USA: D&P reaffirms ITT Hartford credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: D&P reaffirms ITT Hartford credit ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it has reaffirmed its debt and claims paying ability ratings of ITT Hartford Group Inc after the financial services company announced $690 million in after-tax charges.
ITT Hartford took the charges against its 1996 third quarter earnings to cover an increase in reserves for asbestos and environmental claims.

D&P said the charges were somewhat higher than it had expected. However, D&P said it expects ITT Hartford's profits to improve without the drag on earnings, uncertainty as to ultimate costs, and financing planned to replenish capital.
D&P said it believes that ITT Hartford's analysis was thorough and represented a good faith effort to establish an adequate reserve.
D&P also said it expects the company to finance the charge before the end of 1996 by issuing about $500 million of quarterly income preferred stock (QUIPS).
DCR has assigned a preliminary rating of single-A to the proposed QUIPS issuance.

The following ITT Hartford ratings were reaffirmed: senior debt at single-A-plus and commercial paper at D-one; Hartford Capital I's quarterly income preferred stock at single-A; Hartford Fire Intercompany Pool's claims paying ability at double-A; Hartford Life Companies' claims paying ability at double-A-plus; and American Maturity Life Insurance Company claims paying ability at double-A-plus.
